notes.title: Text overhaul and bug fixes
notes.notes: Updated Text Mesh Pro to the latest version to improve text quality and also fixed known bug for the desert destroyers encounter where the boss battle does not reset after subsequently returning to the encounter.

notes.title: Cadava Update 1
notes.notes:
Today we bring you some small fixes which will make the game perform better and a known bug that causes the Desert Destroyers arena match to go directly to the boss battle after you complete the encounter once. 

Thank you to all the players who uncovered bugs and reported them to our studios.
